name: Hesitation_1
short_caption: The robot looks around hesitantly, slightly raising its right hand as if unsure of what to do next.
movement_description: The robot begins by tilting and turning its head to its right, while subtly lifting its right arm with a loose hand. It then shifts its gaze and turns its head to the left, momentarily pointing its right index finger forward before relaxing its hand into a soft fist. Finally, the robot turns its head back to the center and lowers its right arm, returning to a fully neutral resting posture.
safety_notes: The movement is small, slow, and kept close to the torso, posing no safety concerns.
